name: Pumpernickel
siboNotes: Traditional pumpernickel may be better tolerated than regular wheat bread due to the fermentation process, but should still be limited to small portions during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Choose authentic German-style pumpernickel made with sourdough fermentation
Start with half a slice to test tolerance
Pair with low-FODMAP toppings to create a balanced meal
alternatives: Gluten-free bread made from rice or oat flour
pairsWellWith: Fresh herbs like chives or dill
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in B vitamins, especially thiamine and niacin
Good source of dietary fiber for digestive health
Provides complex carbohydrates for sustained energy
